registerRules.pattern: 邏輯閉環|降維打擊|底層邏輯|顆粒度|賦能|拉胯|心態崩了|秒懂|小夥伴|給力
registerRules.remedy: Replace mainland corporate/internet slang with natural Traditional Chinese phrasing.

registerRules.pattern: (?:(?:子|丑|寅|卯|辰|巳|午|未|申|酉|戌|亥)時(?:九|十[一二]?)刻|(?:九|十[一二三四五六七八九]?|[二三四五六七八九]十[一二三四五六七八九]?)刻鐘)
registerRules.remedy: A traditional shichen holds at most 8 ke; fix invalid traditional time count.

registerRules.pattern: 殊不知|他作夢也沒想到|只是此刻他還不知道|誰也沒有注意到角落裡
registerRules.remedy: Keep strict limited POV without omniscient spoilers.

dialogueHygieneRules.remedy: Place sentence-ending punctuation inside the closing corner quotation mark (「……」), not outside.
Use a comma instead of a colon after a mid-dialogue attribution tag.

fillerRules.pattern: 免得[^，。！？\r\n]{0,24}(?:看出端倪|惹來盤問|生出疑心|引人注意|露出馬腳)
fillerRules.remedy: Cut explanatory purpose tails; let physical actions carry subtext.

fillerRules.pattern: 您(?:老人家)?先歇著|慢走不送|不得不說的是|轉眼間便來到了
fillerRules.remedy: Trim exit pleasantries and narrator bridge glue.
